description: Returns the JSON Schema of the `data` object a template expects and the sample data it was designed with, from its published version, else its latest draft. Call it after list_templates and before render or validate_template, to build data that fits; ad-hoc html has no stored schema to read. When the template stores no schema, one is inferred from the sample data: treat that as a guide, not a contract. Read-only and free; an unknown slug returns an error.

template.description: Slug (e.g. invoice) or tpl_ id, as list_templates returns them

name: get_template_schema
title: Get the data schema of a template
